slot_notes.coverage: Semantic slots follow the source diagram and retain exact editable binding order; footer and page number are excluded.
slot_notes.cardinality: Each example value supplies nonempty text for every source run. Fixed boxes require source-comparable line lengths.
slot_notes.style_profile: No semantic color role is exposed: remaining explicit fills are tied to layer/category/status semantics, opaque art, or backgrounds, so a safe single-purpose semantic role was not established.

style_notes: Source typography, geometry, theme, logos, and diagram meaning are retained.
No role-safe bounded color profile is declared; source fills carry category, status, background, or artwork meaning.
opaque_areas: Central Intellio Evolve mark, connector arrows, and sidebar icons are retained source artwork. Vendor and product names in the input/integration lists remain visible and source-specific.
retained_source_content: Footer/legal line and slide number are source-bound.
Reference vendor/product names and source logos remain visible where present; examples are not represented as a clean client deliverable.
limitations: Fixed source geometry and binding cardinality; no dynamic reflow or variable item count.
Editable example copy is illustrative and has not been natively fit or visually qualified after these edits.
Retained source logos, branded diagrams, and source-specific claims require review before client use.

changed_content_coverage.coverage: illustrative modernisation planning copy; source logos, footer, page number, and disclosed diagrams remain
